[EN] Mission Orders

Vampir nobles in the Citadel of Torment are spreading their corruption throughout the surrounding areas.

Kill the {@LinkCreature:33#3#vampir noblewomen}, {@LinkCreature:33#53#cursed vampir noblewomen}, {@LinkCreature:33#4#vampir gentlemen}, {@LinkCreature:33#54#cursed vampir gentlemen}, {@LinkCreature:33#5#cursed jesters}, {@LinkCreature:33#55#infernal jesters}, {@LinkCreature:33#6#malevolent wraiths}, and {@LinkCreature:33#7#eldritch defenders}.

Report to Celion when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los vampir nobles en la Citadel of Torment están esparciendo su corrupción por las áreas circundantes.

Mata a los {@LinkCreature:33#3#vampir noblewomen}, {@LinkCreature:33#53#cursed vampir noblewomen}, {@LinkCreature:33#4#vampir gentlemen}, {@LinkCreature:33#54#cursed vampir gentlemen}, {@LinkCreature:33#5#cursed jesters}, {@LinkCreature:33#55#infernal jesters}, {@LinkCreature:33#6#malevolent wraiths} y {@LinkCreature:33#7#eldritch defenders}.

Preséntate ante Celion cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] It's a reward from the federation. Blessings to all the members of the guild!
[ES] Es una recompensa de la federación. ¡Bendiciones para todos los miembros del gremio!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
